english:
Gain the following benefits while you are unaffected by Pervading Darkness:
• 25%|50%|75%|125%|150% increased Grenade Ability Damage
• 50%|100%|150%|200%|250% additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate

Effects increase per copy, up to 5 copies.
